title: New Samsung Leak 🎧
body: Photos and specs of Samsung’s new Galaxy Buds Active earbuds appeared before the official announcement: an ear-hook design that keeps the buds in place during sports, IP68 water and dust resistance, active noise cancellation, 3D surround sound, and high-quality audio at 96kHz.
Notably, the earbuds do not pause automatically when removed from the ear, because they have no wear sensor.
Simply put: earbuds designed for athletes who want a fully secure fit while moving, even if that costs some smart features.
Do you prefer ear-hook earbuds for sports, or the regular design?
